name: Cinacalcet
route_note: oral tablet once or twice daily with food

discovery.note: Developed after the cloning of the calcium-sensing receptor in 1993.

tagline: The first calcimimetic, which makes the parathyroid gland 'see' more calcium
summary: Cinacalcet was the first calcimimetic drug, a positive allosteric modulator of the calcium-sensing receptor on parathyroid cells. By increasing the receptor's sensitivity to calcium it lowers parathyroid hormone secretion, and is used for secondary hyperparathyroidism in dialysis and for hypercalcaemia in parathyroid carcinoma and primary hyperparathyroidism.
mechanism: The calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) is a G-protein-coupled receptor on parathyroid chief cells; when extracellular calcium rises, CaSR activation suppresses PTH synthesis and release. Cinacalcet binds the receptor's transmembrane domain and increases its sensitivity to extracellular calcium.
PTH secretion therefore falls within hours, followed by reductions in serum calcium and, in dialysis patients, the calcium–phosphate product.
uses: Secondary hyperparathyroidism in chronic kidney disease on dialysis
Primary hyperparathyroidism when parathyroidectomy is not possible

history.title: CaSR cloned
history.detail: Edward Brown and colleagues clone the calcium-sensing receptor.

history.title: First calcimimetic approved
history.detail: FDA approves Sensipar in March 2004; the EU approves Mimpara in October 2004.

history.title: Primary hyperparathyroidism
history.detail: FDA extends approval to primary hyperparathyroidism unsuitable for surgery.

history.title: EVOLVE
history.detail: EVOLVE in 3,883 dialysis patients does not significantly reduce death or major cardiovascular events in the primary analysis.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: Generic cinacalcet launches in the US and Europe.

pk.metabolism: hepatic CYP3A4, CYP2D6 and CYP1A2; strong CYP2D6 inhibitor

facts: Cinacalcet was the first approved drug acting as an allosteric modulator of a G-protein-coupled receptor.
Etelcalcetide is a later intravenous calcimimetic given at dialysis.
